name: Seeds Layouts
description: Layouts for Layout Builder across CSS frameworks.
project_description:
Whatever the frontend framework you are using Seeds Layouts developed to enhance the Layout builder experience and make configuring sections more end-user oriented.

 This module is hitting a lot of birds in one stone , and could be used as an alternative for the following modules.

 
 Bootstrap Layouts 
 Foundation Layouts 
 Layout Section Classes 
 Layout Builder Styles 
 
 Seeds Layouts built to provide the following:

 
 
 Layouts: 
 Currently, we are providing one column, two columns, and three columns layouts.

 
 
 Layout custom options: 
 You can add a custom option using a checkbox or select list and these options will be added as classes on your section.

 

 
 
 Layout background: 
 Enjoy the ability to upload a background for your section within the layout builder.
